falsePositives.reason: Outside the reviewed change: step 8's outcome list already enumerated 8 items inline at base; the diff appended casual-locked to a pre-existing violation. The diff-caused over-cap enumeration is the Disposition ledger (G2-133), matched by r2-code-style-MIN-28-r2.
Not a defect: the reserved-name cases the plan assigns to TestRepoValidate exist under TestRegistryAdd; a test-name mismatch against the plan changes no behavior or coverage.
Outside the reviewed range: the git * log* / branch* / show* / status* allow rules are unchanged by this diff, as the finding itself states.

Not a defect. The casual lockout protects shipped skills; the diff states explicitly that new-skill proposals stay allowed and get stamped origin: user. The stamp only makes a skill editable by the same pipeline and grants no privilege, and vote-less creation under auto-apply was there before this diff.
Outside the reviewed range: the unverified curl downloads of jq.exe and peek-mcp.exe were already there at base; the diff only bumps the peek-mcp release tag on an existing line.
Outside the reviewed range: the --serena `uv tool install --upgrade serena-agent` line is untouched by the diff.

Not a defect: the new loadedModTime/loadedSize fields sit under the mutex that guards them, as RULE-GOLANG-GR-007 requires (mutex directly above guarded state); the struct's path/mu/repos order was non-alphabetical at base.
Outside the reviewed range: runWithTimeout does not exist at the reviewed head; it was introduced by this run's own round-1 fix (r1-code-style-MIN-5-r1).
Outside the reviewed range: the runWithTimeout calls in Run/RunSync were introduced by this run's own round-1 fix, not by the reviewed diff.
Outside the reviewed range: the '.'/'..' traversal guard in Repo.Validate was added by this run's round-1 fix (r1-security-NIT-2-r1); it does not exist at the reviewed head.
Not a defect: no repo rule or doc prescribes '// ---- Stage' banners, and most workflow scripts (e.g. railroad-review.js) do not use them.

uncataloged.reason: Genuine and in range. The new writeInstallEnv writes install.env from the -peek-port/-peek-control-port flags, and install.ps1 always passes its defaults (4242/42442), so re-running install.ps1 without arguments resets a profile's customized ports. install.sh in the same diff sources the existing install.env first and preserves them.

Genuine and in range: the new config.LoadFragment has no test at the reviewed head (no _test.go references it); its missing-file and parse-error-after-expansion branches are unpinned. G2-168 covers the caller switches, not LoadFragment itself.
Genuine and in range: the diff's new NotFound + DefaultDisabled skip in sched_windows.go SyncAll has no test at the reviewed head. G2-044 catalogs only the darwin twin.

Genuine and in range: the diff makes Repo.Name a sessions/ mining-folder segment and reserves default/archived, but namePattern still admits '.' and '..', so the new reservation is incomplete. Low severity, since no Go path sink consumes Name.

Genuine and in range: refreshIfChanged (new in the diff) records no file identity after a failed Reload, so a malformed repos.json is re-stat'ed, re-read, re-parsed and re-logged on every Find()/Repos() call.

Genuine and in range: at the reviewed head, handleWelcomeBootstrap passes the os.OpenFile log error bare to respond.WithInternalServerError but wraps the cmd.Start error with the function prefix. The finding cites the post-fix CreateTemp form of the same line.
